Scope.description: What a key may be used for.

oneOf.description:
Read jobs, runs, definitions, Harness² and metrics, and call tools
that only read.
Chat, through MCP or the front door, and mark a run good or bad.
Start workflow runs, and call tools that change something.
Start Harness² attempts, revert its changes and hold agents.

expires_at.description: When it stops working. It never does if left out.

name.description: What it's for, such as "Claude Code on the desktop".

person.description: Whose it is: `person:` and their slug.

private_by_default.description:
True if what it starts is private to its person unless a request
says otherwise. False if left out.

scopes.description: What it may be used for. Each must be one the person's role allows.
